scope: Codex parallel audio/text/input/localization service work; renderer/native level work belongs to Claude

implementation.audio: Shared scoped CPU mixer, pools/random containers/spatial attenuation/pan/occlusion lowpass/buses/ducking, streaming music/fades/crossfades/loop points/rate-pitch and reflective Audio API
implementation.text: Rustybuzz/bidi/UAX14+documented CJK tailoring, fallback, ruby/vertical rich layout/icons/outline/shadow/grapheme events, CPU RGBA and SDF atlas
implementation.input: Runtime rebind/capture/profiles, analog/dead zone/edge state, optional GilRs desktop backend and semantic prompt tokens
implementation.localization: Scoped catalogs, CLDR plurals, font-alias selection, explicit profile persistence
implementation.engine_surfaces: Text class publishes client-scoped surfaces, advances reveal and exports/restores explicit logical checkpoints
integration_fixes: VFS capability-only seekable disk files preserve provider precedence
No double playback: App PCM vs plain runtime legacy device paths
Text reveal/event rollback on publication or queue overflow
PCM restore epoch flushes software queue and source block; endpoint clamps final samples
Background gamepad routing suppressed; focus/suspend clear state and cancel rebind
Surface budgets/revisions validate before insertion; client-scoped release

limits: Advanced audio voices/buses and text/localization/input session config are not automatic Runtime snapshot contents; explicit config/state APIs are documented
Decode/mixing on App thread, no hard realtime, independent time stretch or HRTF
No actual soundcard listening or hardware gamepad validation
CJK prohibition is a documented subset; full UAX50/TCY/advanced ruby variants not complete
MCP remains its existing fresh-process service; live MCP attachment not added
No native Siglus original-video/audio/save equivalence claim
asset_policy: No fonts/game assets/credentials/SDKs added; system fonts are read at runtime by ignored tests; previews stay external
